title: Sound Check: Auditing Audio Datasets
findings: The study found significant representation bias in the audited audio datasets. Transcripts contained far fewer mentions of marginalized groups. Specifically, the keyword 'Muslim' appeared 5-10 times less frequently than 'Christian', and 'Jewish' also appeared infrequently, indicating underrepresentation of these religious groups.
